title: David, Nabal, and Abigail

questions.question: Who died at the beginning of this chapter?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 25:1 (ESV): “Now Samuel died. And all Israel assembled and mourned for him...”

questions.question: How was Nabal described?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 25:3 (ESV): “...The man was harsh and badly behaved; he was a Calebite.”

questions.question: How was Abigail described?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 25:3 (ESV): “...The woman was discerning and beautiful...”

questions.question: How did David react to Nabal’s insult?
options: He girded on his sword and prepared to attack
questions.correctAnswer: He girded on his sword and prepared to attack
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 25:13 (ESV): “And David said to his men, ‘Every man strap on his sword!’...”

questions.question: What did Abigail do when she heard of the danger?
options: She brought food and met David
questions.correctAnswer: She brought food and met David
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 25:18 (ESV): “Then Abigail made haste and took two hundred loaves and two skins of wine...”

questions.question: What happened to Nabal when he heard what Abigail did?
options: His heart died within him, and he became as a stone
questions.correctAnswer: His heart died within him, and he became as a stone
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 25:37 (ESV): “...and his heart died within him, and he became as a stone.”

questions.question: How many days later did Nabal die?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 25:38 (ESV): "And about ten days later the LORD struck Nabal, and he died."

questions.question: What did David do after Nabal died?
options: He sent and proposed to Abigail
questions.correctAnswer: He sent and proposed to Abigail
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 25:39 (ESV): "...Then David sent and spoke to Abigail to take her as his wife."

questions.question: Who was David's other wife mentioned in this chapter?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 25:43 (ESV): "David also took Ahinoam of Jezreel, and both of them became his wives."

questions.question: What happened to Michal, David's wife?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 25:44 (ESV): "Saul had given Michal his daughter, David's wife, to Palti..."

questions.question: What does Nabal's name mean according to Abigail?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 25:25 (ESV): "...for as his name is, so is he. Nabal is his name, and folly is with him..."

questions.question: What did Abigail say referring to David's life being bound?
options: Bound in the bundle of the living in the care of the Lord
Written in the book of life
questions.correctAnswer: Bound in the bundle of the living in the care of the Lord
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 25:29 (ESV): "...the life of my lord shall be bound in the bundle of the living in the care of the LORD your God."

questions.question: What was Nabal doing when Abigail returned?
options: Holding a feast like the feast of a king and was drunk
questions.correctAnswer: Holding a feast like the feast of a king and was drunk
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 25:36 (ESV): "...he was holding a feast in his house, like the feast of a king. And Nabal's heart was merry within him, for he was very drunk."

questions.question: Where was Nabal shearing his sheep?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 25:2 (ESV): "...and he was shearing his sheep in Carmel."

questions.question: David thanked God for keeping him from ______?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 25:33 (ESV): "...and blessed be you, who have kept me this day from bloodguilt and from working salvation with my own hand."

key_verse_text: And David said to Abigail, “Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who sent you this day to meet me!” (ESV)
